The bean fills about 70 percent of the picture's width: smooth matte skin, colour peach to lit cream in the middle with a rust-brown edge, glowing softly from WITHIN (a gentle warm inner light, strongest in its middle), seen straight-on from the front in soft warm daylight from the upper left. The bean has NO dot, NO eye, NO spot, NO mark, NO sprout, NO leaf, NO stem, NOTHING embryo-like or creature-like: just a plain smooth glowing bean. The moss under it is leaf-green, lit grass and shaded hollow forest moss, a small soft mound only as wide as the bean, no twigs, no stones. Soft painted forms, matte, no ink outlines, no highlights, nothing glossy, no chrome, no cool or blue light. No text, letters or digits.
